## Momo Office 0.6.0 — original pixel-art office

Download **Momo-Office-0.6.0-Setup.exe**, close the old app, and run Setup. Existing agents, prompts and settings are preserved. The dedicated installer folder, uninstaller and loading screen remain.

- Original 16×16 tilemap art driven by server layout coordinates; depth-sorted furniture, licensed character sheets and an original four-direction pixel cat.
- Integer rendering/zoom, bitmap typography, local-time day/night lighting, seasonal windows and optional weather.
- Wooden HUD, clock and cosmetic completed-request counter, Quest log, Journal, portrait dialogues, and all existing prompt/settings/copy/save/cancel behavior.
- 1×–3× HUD scale, high-contrast panels, optional pixel cursor, keyboard navigation and reduced-motion behavior.
- Optional synthesized sound and original music, muted by default and started only by a user gesture.

All new art and sound are original MIT project assets. Third-party assets: Silkscreen (SIL OFL 1.1); MetroCity characters (CC0 1.0) with Pixel Agents adaptations (MIT). See CREDITS.md. No Stardew Valley assets are included.

The 60 fps / 1080p / ten-agent target remains unverified on real Windows hardware. Shared headless Canvas 2D tests measured roughly 27–31 fps; this is documented rather than claimed as passing.

The installer is unsigned. Compare SHA256SUMS.txt or the installer .sha256 file before running. Cloud remains optional and off by default; AI tests use mock completions. Ollama is a separate prerequisite.
